name: Sakashita Nachi
source:
One of the Hakkenshi, he holds the mark of 'wisdom' on his body.
A real man, but he's often mistaken for a cross-dressing woman.
He has a strong sense of justice, the strict noble type.
A serious and stubborn person who wont stray from his path once he makes a decision.
